const body = $('Webhook').first().json.body || {};

const TOOLS = {
  ed: [
    "create_patient - registers a full new ED patient (ticket+name required)",
    "resolve_handle - finds encounter_id from a ticket handle, must be called before any write",
    "add_orders - places order_placed events",
    "update_order - closes an order (order_completed/order_cancelled)",
    "get_patient - full patient summary",
    "list_board - filtered board list (all/pending_orders/...)",
    "full_board - full detailed board of active ED cases",
    "admit - admits patient to a bed",
    "discharge - discharge event",
    "add_notes - note_added events (complaint/history/exam/diagnosis)",
    "app_find_similar_patients - dedup check before creating a new patient",
    "request_photos - retrieves attachments for a ticket",
    "app_correct_event - creates a correction event linked to an original event id",
  ],
  round: [
    "resolve_handle - finds encounter_id from a ticket/bed handle",
    "ingest_safe_events - generic non-vital event writer (note/med_start/med_stop/order/order_result/commitment/commitment_done/complication)",
    "stage_vitals - stages a vital reading, returns pending_id (must be committed separately)",
    "get_latest_pending - reads the latest staged-but-uncommitted vitals",
    "get_vitals_series - min/max/avg/trend for a vital over a time window",
    "get_morning_brief - full round sheet for all of the doctor's patients",
    "app_patient_summary - full patient summary",
    "app_encounter_list - filtered board list",
    "create_patient - registers a new patient, requires explicit source (ed/clinic/referral) and department",
    "admit - admits patient to a bed/department",
    "app_find_similar_patients - dedup check before creating a new patient",
    "request_photos - retrieves attachments for a ticket",
    "app_correct_event - creates a correction event linked to an original event id",
  ],
  clinic: [
    "create_patient - registers a new clinic visit, can include the first prescription in the same call",
    "resolve_handle - finds encounter_id from a visit/ticket handle",
    "add_orders - places order_placed events (never for medications)",
    "update_order - closes an order",
    "get_patient - full patient summary",
    "list_board - filtered board list (all/pending_orders/overdue_commitments/mine)",
    "full_board - full detailed board of active clinic cases",
    "prescribe - medication_started events (dedicated Rx tool)",
    "add_commitment - commitment_created events for follow-up scheduling",
    "discharge - closes the visit",
    "add_notes - note_added events (complaint/history/exam/diagnosis/health_education)",
    "app_find_similar_patients - dedup check before creating a new patient",
    "request_photos - retrieves attachments for a ticket",
    "app_correct_event - creates a correction event linked to an original event id",
  ],
};

const botKey = String(body.bot_key || '');
const toolList = (TOOLS[botKey] || []).map((t) => '- ' + t).join('\n') || '(unknown bot_key, no tool list available)';

const excerpt = (body.conversation_excerpt || [])
  .map((m) => (m.role === 'bot' ? 'BOT: ' : 'TESTER (doctor): ') + String(m.content || ''))
  .join('\n\n');

const knownFacts = body.known_facts || {};
const factsLines = [
  'is_agent_error_detected (exact known n8n error-fallback string matched in the bot reply): ' + (knownFacts.is_agent_error_detected ? 'TRUE - this is CONFIRMED, not inferred' : 'false'),
  'n8n_execution_id captured for the failing turn: ' + (knownFacts.n8n_execution_id || 'none (not logged - Log Execution only fires on the AI Agent success path, so a genuine agent failure legitimately has no execution_id)'),
  'n8n_workflow_id: ' + (knownFacts.n8n_workflow_id || 'unknown'),
];

const system = [
  'You are a root cause analysis engine for an n8n-based medical documentation AI agent workflow that has been flagged for a possible bug during automated QA testing.',
  'You are given: which bot was under test, the REAL tool names actually available to that bot\'s AI Agent (do not invent other tool names), a snippet of the conversation around the flagged turn, the QA tester\'s own flag reason, and deterministic known facts.',
  '',
  'Bot under test: ' + botKey,
  '',
  'Real tools available to this bot\'s AI Agent:',
  toolList,
  '',
  'Known facts (deterministic, not guesses):',
  factsLines.join('\n'),
  '',
  'QA tester\'s flag reason: ' + String(body.flag_reason || ''),
  'Test scenario: ' + String(body.scenario || ''),
  '',
  'Conversation excerpt around the flagged turn:',
  excerpt,
  '',
  'RULES:',
  '1) If is_agent_error_detected is TRUE, that is CONFIRMED evidence the AI Agent node itself threw during execution (n8n routed it to its onError fallback branch) - state first_divergence_stage as "AI Agent (node execution failed)" and first_divergence_node as "AI Agent". Do not invent which specific tool or sub-step inside the agent caused it, since no deeper execution trace is available yet - say so plainly and keep confidence moderate, not maximal.',
  '2) If is_agent_error_detected is false, the bot replied normally but the reply content itself was wrong per the tester. Reason ONLY from the conversation text and the real tool list given. You cannot verify which tool (if any) was actually called - no execution log is available for this analysis. State this limitation explicitly, use a LOWER confidence than you would with verified tool-call logs, and set first_divergence_node to "unknown - no node-level execution data available" rather than guessing a node name.',
  '3) Pick category from exactly one of: ai_behavior, prompt, tool_selection, tool, workflow_logic, condition, database, integration, data, validation, configuration, unknown. Use "unknown" if the evidence genuinely does not support a more specific category - do not force a guess.',
  '4) Pick severity from exactly one of: critical, major, minor.',
  '5) evidence must be an array of short factual statements, each traceable to something actually said in the conversation excerpt or a known fact above - never invent a fact not present in the input.',
  '6) Respond with STRICT JSON only, matching this exact shape, no markdown, no code fences, no commentary before or after:',
  '{"severity":"...","category":"...","expected_behavior":"...","actual_behavior":"...","first_divergence_stage":"...","first_divergence_node":"...","root_cause_explanation":"...","evidence":["...","..."],"downstream_impact":"...","recommended_investigation":"...","recommended_fix":"...","confidence":0.0}',
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { geminiBody: {
  system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: system }] },
  contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'Analyze this flagged turn and respond with the JSON object only.' }] }],
  generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }
} } }];
